context_notes.relay.shell.usage.unit_credits: Localized unit noun for API token credits. {count} is the SAME actual finite numeric measurement selected by remaining ?? used, never formatted text or the used_fraction fallback. ICU cardinal plural follows the actual served catalogue locale; Python count is int|float, phone count is number. Render the NOUN ONLY: do not insert # or repeat the count, because the outer amount message formats/prints the number exactly once. Supply needed CLDR forms for zero, one, two, fractions, negative magnitudes and large exact numeric values; other is mandatory. French exact numeric million uses its many branch with a plain plural noun and NO de (OQLF numeric-versus-spelled-million guidance); do not apply the spelled-out un million de rule to the displayed digits. Spanish exact numeric million uses many with de plus the plural noun (RAE cardinales section 6); coordinate the outer message so de occurs exactly once. Russian fractional other uses the native fractional case, not the integer-many noun form. USD stays a fixed invariant label with no count parameter and is not a conversion. Never interpolate the raw API token. English 1 credit/token/request is an intentional correction of the former fixed-plural defect, not byte-identical English extraction parity.

native_rule: Russian fractional decimal quantities govern genitive singular: 1,5 кредита / 1,5 токена / 1,5 запроса. Hence other noun forms кредита/токена/запроса are correct; integer many instead uses кредитов/токенов/запросов (0, 5, 1000000). This agrees with new notes and the previously executed native audit. No fresh native coverage asserted.
